videos.title: Hall of Champions Valorant 2021-2026
videos.caption:
Dari Acend sampai LOUD, siapa juara Valorant Champions paling ikonik menurut kamu? 🏆

2021 Berlin: Acend (cNed, starxo, zeek, Kiles, BONECOLD), 3-2 vs Gambit
2022 Istanbul: LOUD (aspas, Less, Sacy, pANcada, Saadhak), 3-1 vs OpTic
2023 Los Angeles: Evil Geniuses (Demon1, Ethan, jawgemo, Boostio, C0M), 3-1 vs Paper Rex
2024 Seoul: EDward Gaming (ZmjjKK, nobody, CHICHOO, Smoggy, S1Mon), 3-2 vs Team Heretics
2025 Paris: NRG (brawk, mada, s0m, Ethan, skuba), 3-2 vs Fnatic
2026 Shanghai: LOUD (erde, Darker, luk xo, DaviH, tkzin), 3-1 vs Team Vitality

LOUD jadi organisasi pertama yang juara 2×, tapi rosternya beda total dari 2022. Ethan juga juara 2× bareng EG & NRG!
